nodes.body: Thanks @ckl117! I'm fairly sure this is already on main - the fused clip+swiglu+fp8 per-token-group quant for the DSv4 shared expert and EP normal paths landed via #24897 (`deepseek_v2.py`, `deep_gemm.py` call `silu_and_mul_contig_post_quant`), and #34926 made the fusion unconditional, removing the env gate this PR adds. Closing as superseded; please reopen if I've missed a case.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces an early exit for empty batches in the SiLU and multiplication post-quantization kernel, updates the deep GEMM runner conditions to support SwiGLU clamp fusion on CUDA, and extends the DeepSeek-V2 model's down-projection weight type checks to include FP8 (torch.float8_e4m3fn). The review feedback suggests deferring the early exit in the CUDA kernel until after all input validations are complete to prevent silent failures, and adding a _is_cuda check in the DeepSeek-V2 model to avoid runtime crashes on non-CUDA platforms.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The [consumer version of Gemini Code Assist on GitHub](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/review-repo-code) is being sunset. Starting **June 18, 2026**, new organization installations will be blocked, and all code review activity will officially cease on **July 17, 2026**.
> For more details on the timeline and next steps, please review the [Help Documentation](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/deprecations/consumer-code-review).

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

To ensure robust validation and adhere to defensive programming practices, all input tensors, shapes, and dimensions should be fully verified before any early exit. Currently, the early exit for `num_tokens == 0` is placed before `output_scale` and dimension checks, which can lead to silent failures or passing invalid tensors for empty batches. We should defer the early exit until after all validations are complete.

```
    const auto num_tokens = static_cast<uint32_t>(M.unwrap());
```

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

The fused path utilizes `deep_gemm_wrapper.gemm_nt_f8f8bf16`, which is only supported on CUDA platforms. On non-CUDA platforms (such as ROCm/HIP or NPU) where FP8 quantization is enabled and `weight_scale_inv` is present, this block could be entered and cause a runtime crash. Adding a check for `_is_cuda` ensures safety and correctness across all supported hardware backends.

```suggestion
        if (
            _is_cuda
            and self.swiglu_limit is not None
            and not self.down_proj.reduce_results
            and (
                self.down_proj.weight.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn
                or self.down_proj.weight.dtype == torch.uint8
            )
            and hasattr(self.down_proj, "weight_scale_inv")
        ):
```
